violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Walk in freezer contained food boxes on the floor. There were frozen food covered with frost.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Containers of food stored on floor in walk in cooler.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Bleach sanitizer proper concentration is 50 ppm for wiping counters.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. Observed grease buildup around fryer, stove where food is prepared.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Ceiling tiles contained water stains over drink area and in cooking area.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Observed grease and debris build up around cooking area. Observed debris buildup around drink bar.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Observed grease, dust debris in and round vent a hood system.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. To go trays and pizza boxes were stored directly on the floor.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Observed dirt and grease buildup on walls and cealing.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. No Servsafe certificate available.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Outside freezer had open boxes stored on floor.

Hot storage of potentially hazardous food. — --Hot food storage facilities/equipment was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining temperature of potentially hazardous food at 140F or greater. Chicken strips, sandwiches in hot hold unable to maintain 140 degrees or higher.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Observed open containers of Mrs Gerry's not marked with date. Sandwich meat and cheese in zip bags not date marked.

Time as a public health control. — --Food was not marked or identified with the time within which it must be cooked, served, or discarded. Observed food in hot hold not marked with time made or discard time.--Written procedures were not maintained or made available to the regulatory authority. Manager states no written policy.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Manager states ice cream machine cleaned monthly. Ice cream machine needs to be cleaned more frequent.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Observed dust and debris on ventilation hood. Needs to be cleaned more frequent.
